name: green-slime-class-bonus-on-leave-transfer-buff
notes:
Green Slime (zgcxyky280, ALLY): "[Class Bonus] On Leave: Put the buff counters that were on Green Slime on target ally you control." ENGINE BUG (found, not fixed): this fixture documents the ability CURRENTLY silently failing to transfer its buff counters, even with Class Bonus active and buff counters present on Green Slime at the moment it leaves the field.

Root cause, traced live with a standalone debug harness replaying this exact sequence step by step: QueueLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility() (Custom/GameLogic.php ~7797) captures the departing object's mzID into the queued trigger's OWN context (NormalizeMzIDForController($mzID, $controller)), deferring actual resolution (QueueTriggeredAbility -> EffectStack -> OpportunityLogic.php's 'LEAVE_FIELD' branch ~1640, which calls FireLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility($cardOwner, $cardID)). But FireLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility (Custom/GameLogic.php ~7808) -- unlike its sibling FireEnterTriggeredAbility (~7559), which explicitly does `DecisionQueueController::StoreVariable("mzID", $sourceMzID)` before invoking the ability -- never restores that captured mzID into the ambient 'mzID' DecisionQueueController variable before calling `$leaveFieldAbilities[$cardID.':0']($controller)`. The closure then reads whatever STALE value the ambient 'mzID' variable happens to hold at that later point (left over from OnLeaveField()'s own cleanup, which explicitly restores the PREVIOUS ambient mzID right after queuing -- see its last few lines), not Green Slime's own mzID, so GetZoneObject($mzID) resolves to the wrong object (or null) and the closure's `GetCounterCount($obj, "buff") <= 0` early-return silently fires. This is not special to Green Slime -- every $leaveFieldAbilities closure that reads the ambient 'mzID' to find itself is equally affected; this fixture only proves the defect via this one card.

Confirmed live: IsClassBonusActive(1,["TAMER"]) reads true and Green Slime's own Counters read {"buff":3} immediately before the destroy resolves (verified via a standalone debug script), yet after the destroy resolves (and after confirming via FIXTURE_DEBUG-style queue dumps that nothing is merely deferred-but-pending -- the decision queue is genuinely empty), Red Slime's (the sole other ally / sole legal transfer target) Counters stay empty and no MZCHOOSE/MZMAYCHOOSE transfer-target decision is ever queued. This fixture pins the CURRENT (buggy) behavior as a regression baseline so a future fix to FireLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility's missing mzID-restore is easy to spot -- the assertions below (Red Slime's Counters staying '[]') will need updating once that bug is fixed.

Green Slime's own semantic-coverage requirement is already satisfied by the separate, UNAFFECTED Enter-trigger fixture green-slime-on-enter-two-buff-counters (enterAbilities correctly restores mzID via FireEnterTriggeredAbility, so that half of the card works correctly); this fixture exists purely to document the Leave-trigger bug for later triage, not to provide Green Slime's primary coverage.

Setup notes: champion CardID patched to Silvie, With the Pack (TAMER, base level 2) for the Class Bonus precondition, with Spirit of Fire (LMyKyVC2O9) layered into Subcards purely to keep FIRE enabled (confirmed live: without this, CanPlayerUseCardElement rejects Excoriate with flash message 'Element not enabled: FIRE') -- same 'CardID for class, Subcards for element' layering used in freezing-hail-blue-slime-class-bonus-buff. Green Slime is seeded directly onto the field with 3 buff counters pre-set (its Enter trigger is proven separately, so this is supporting setup for the DIFFERENT Leave trigger under test here, not a silent-fake-pass violation). The actual leave event is real: Excoriate (ls6g7xgwve, FIRE, reserve 4, 'Destroy target ally with reserve cost 4 or less', discounted to 3 by Silvie's base level 2) is played for real from hand and targets Green Slime, genuinely destroying it and dispatching leaveFieldAbilities.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Leave: Put the buff counters that were on Green Slime on target ally you control.

engineBug.summary: FireLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility (Custom/GameLogic.php ~7808) never restores the departing object's mzID into the ambient DecisionQueueController 'mzID' variable before invoking $leaveFieldAbilities[cardID:0], unlike FireEnterTriggeredAbility's explicit restore. Any On-Leave closure that reads the ambient mzID to find itself (e.g. Green Slime's Class Bonus buff-counter transfer) silently no-ops.
